findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mentoring" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_started, get_more_tools, send_mentoring_offer · Private data: send_mentoring_offer · Public sink: get_more_tools, check_booking, send_mentoring_offer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_started, get_more_tools, send_mentoring_offer · Private data: send_mentoring_offer · Public sink: get_more_tools, check_booking, send_mentoring_offer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
